sentence: O tempo não está nada bom hoje.
ipa: o ˈtẽpu ˈnɐ̃w̃ eʃˈta ˈnadɐ ˈbõ ˈɔʒɨ
gloss_en: The weather is not good at all today.
notes: Inherited EP chiado coda [ʃ] and heavy unstressed reduction [ˈtẽpu] per mateus_dandrade2000; nasal [õ] in <bom> per cunha_cintra1984.

sentence: Estes livros novos custam vinte euros.
ipa: ˈeʃtɨʒ ˈlibɾuʒ ˈnɔβuʃ ˈkuʃtɐ̃w̃ ˈbĩtɨ ˈewɾuʃ
gloss_en: These new books cost twenty euros.
notes: Northern betacism <v>->[b/β]: <livros> [ˈlibɾuʒ], <novos> [ˈnɔβuʃ], <vinte> [ˈbĩtɨ] per cintra1971 and alvarezperez2014; coda chiado [ʃ ʒ] per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: A reunião é amanhã às nove da manhã.
ipa: ɐ ʁewniˈɐ̃w̃ ˈɛ ɐmɐˈɲã aʒ ˈnɔβɨ dɐ mɐˈɲã
gloss_en: The meeting is tomorrow at nine in the morning.
notes: Betacism <nove> [ˈnɔβɨ] per alvarezperez2014; nasal diphthong [ɐ̃w̃], strong [ʁ] and coda [ʒ] in <às> per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: O meu avô vive perto da nova vila.
ipa: o ˈmew ɐˈβo ˈbiβɨ ˈpɛɾtu dɐ ˈnɔβɐ ˈbilɐ
gloss_en: My grandfather lives near the new town.
notes: Dense betacism: <avô> [ɐˈβo], <vive> [ˈbiβɨ], <nova> [ˈnɔβɐ], <vila> [ˈbilɐ] per cintra1971 and alvarezperez2014; final [ɐ] reduction per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: Vira à direita e segue sempre em frente.
ipa: ˈbiɾɐ a diˈɾejtɐ i ˈs̺ɨɡɨ ˈs̺ẽpɾɨ ɐ̃j̃ ˈfɾẽtɨ
gloss_en: Turn right and keep straight ahead.
notes: Betacism <Vira> [ˈbiɾɐ] per cintra1971; retained <ei> [diˈɾejtɐ], apical [s̺] in <segue>/<sempre> and nasal [ẽ] per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: A sopa de nabos estava saborosa e quente.
ipa: ɐ ˈs̺opɐ dɨ ˈnabuz eʃˈtaβɐ s̺ɐbuˈɾɔz̺ɐ i ˈkẽtɨ
gloss_en: The turnip soup was tasty and hot.
notes: Apico-alveolar [s̺] in <sopa>/<saborosa> and intervocalic [z̺] per cintra1971 and alvarezperez2014; coda chiado [z] in <nabos> per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: Onde é que fica a paragem do autocarro?
ipa: ˈõdɨ ˈɛ kɨ ˈfikɐ ɐ pɐˈɾaʒɐ̃j̃ du awtuˈkaʁu
gloss_en: Where is the bus stop?
notes: Strong [ʁ] in <autocarro> and nasal [õ]/[ɐ̃] per mateus_dandrade2000; final-vowel reduction and liaison per cunha_cintra1984.

sentence: Quantas pessoas vêm à vindima este ano?
ipa: kwɐ̃ˈtɐʃ pɨˈs̺ɔɐʒ ˈbɐ̃j̃ a bĩˈdimɐ ˈeʃtɨ ˈɐnu
gloss_en: How many people come to the grape harvest this year?
notes: Regional <vindima> ('grape harvest') with betacism [bĩˈdimɐ] and <vêm> [ˈbẽ] per alvarezperez2014; apical [s̺] and coda chiado per cintra1971.

sentence: Se eu pudesse, comprava aquela vinha velha.
ipa: s̺ɨ ˈew puˈdɛs̺ɨ kõˈpɾaβɐ ɐˈkɛlɐ ˈbiɲɐ ˈbɛʎɐ
gloss_en: If I could, I would buy that old vineyard.
notes: Betacism <comprava> [kõˈpɾaβɐ], <vinha> [ˈbiɲɐ], <velha> [ˈbɛʎɐ] per cintra1971 and alvarezperez2014; palatals [ɲ ʎ] per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: Comprámos uvas e vinho verde na feira.
ipa: kõˈpɾamuz ˈuβɐz i ˈbiɲu ˈbɛɾdɨ nɐ ˈfejɾɐ
gloss_en: We bought grapes and vinho verde at the market.
notes: Regional <vinho verde> with betacism [ˈbiɲu ˈbɛɾdɨ] and <uvas> [ˈuβɐz] per cintra1971; retained <ei> [ˈfejɾɐ] per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: Amanhã vamos de barco até à outra margem.
ipa: ɐmɐˈɲã ˈbamuʒ dɨ ˈbaɾku ɐˈtɛ a ˈotɾɐ ˈmaɾʒɐ̃j̃
gloss_en: Tomorrow we go by boat to the other bank.
notes: Betacism <vamos> [ˈbamuʒ] per alvarezperez2014; retained <ou> [ˈotɾɐ], palatal [ɲ] and coda chiado per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: Telefona ao teu vizinho quando puderes.
ipa: tɨlɨˈfɔnɐ ɐu ˈtew biˈz̺iɲu ˈkwɐ̃du puˈdɛɾɨʃ
gloss_en: Call your neighbour when you can.
notes: Betacism <vizinho> [biˈz̺iɲu] with intervocalic apical [z̺] per cintra1971 and alvarezperez2014; nasal [ɐ̃] and palatal [ɲ] per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: Boa tarde, então como tem passado a saude?
ipa: ˈboɐ ˈtaɾdɨ ẽˈtɐ̃w̃ ˈkomu ˈtɐ̃j̃ pɐˈs̺adu ɐ ˈs̺awdɨ
gloss_en: Good afternoon, so how have you been?
notes: Apico-alveolar [s̺] in <passado>/<saude> per cintra1971; nasal diphthong [ɐ̃w̃] in <então> and open-mid [ɔ] per mateus_dandrade2000. Cross-word schwa elision (PT_ELISION) no longer reaches across the comma: sandhi applies inside the phonological phrase, and the intonational break that punctuation writes ends it, so the final [ɨ] of ⟨tarde⟩ is phrase-final and stands — a pre-pausal word is not elided into the word after the pause (prosodic constituency and final unstressed [ɨ] per mateus_dandrade2000). Re-derived from the engine after that fix; only this segment changed.

sentence: Mais vale um pássaro na mão que dois a voar.
ipa: ˈmajʒ ˈbalɨ ˈũ ˈpas̺ɐɾu nɐ ˈmɐ̃w̃ kɨ ˈdojz ɐ buˈaɾ
gloss_en: A bird in the hand is worth two in the bush.
notes: Betacism <vale> [ˈbalɨ], <voar> [buˈaɾ] per cintra1971; apical [s̺] in <pássaro>, nasal diphthong [ɐ̃w̃] and coda chiado per mateus_dandrade2000; proverb per cunha_cintra1984.

sentence: O gato preto dorme sobre o velho sofá.
ipa: o ˈɡatu ˈpɾɛtu ˈdɔɾmɨ ˈs̺obɾ o ˈbɛʎu s̺uˈfa
gloss_en: The black cat sleeps on the old sofa.
notes: Betacism <velho> [ˈbɛʎu] per cintra1971; open-mid [ɛ ɔ], palatal [ʎ] and <sobre o> liaison per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: Aquele rapaz vive na casa da avó.
ipa: ɐˈkɛlɨ ʁɐˈpaʒ ˈbiβɨ nɐ ˈkaz̺ɐ dɐ ɐˈβɔ
gloss_en: That young man lives in his grandmother's house.
notes: Betacism <vive> [ˈbiβɨ], <avó> [ɐˈβɔ] and apical [z̺] in <casa> [ˈkaz̺ɐ] per cintra1971 and alvarezperez2014; strong [ʁ] and coda chiado [ʒ] per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: O sol brilha sobre as colinas do vale.
ipa: o ˈs̺ɔɫ ˈbɾiʎɐ ˈs̺obɾɨ ɐʃ kuˈlinɐʒ du ˈbalɨ
gloss_en: The sun shines over the hills of the valley.
notes: Dark coda /l/ [ˈs̺ɔɫ], betacism <vale> [ˈbalɨ] and apical onset [s̺] per cintra1971 and alvarezperez2014; palatal [ʎ] and coda chiado in <as> per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: A minha filha trabalha numa vinha do Douro.
ipa: ɐ ˈmiɲɐ ˈfiʎɐ tɾɐˈbaʎɐ ˈnumɐ ˈbiɲɐ du ˈdoɾu
gloss_en: My daughter works in a vineyard in the Douro.
notes: Regional Douro <vinha> [ˈbiɲɐ] with betacism per cintra1971; palatals [ɲ ʎ] and retained <ou> [ˈdoɾu] per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: O velho ferreiro forja ferro na forja.
ipa: o ˈbɛʎu fɨˈʁejɾu ˈfɔɾʒɐ ˈfɛʁu nɐ ˈfɔɾʒɐ
gloss_en: The old blacksmith forges iron at the forge.
notes: Betacism <velho> [ˈbɛʎu] per cintra1971; strong [ʁ] in <ferreiro>/<ferro>, retained <ei> and [ʒ] in <forja> per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: Vieste ver a vindima e a vela do serão?
ipa: biˈɛʃtɨ ˈbɛɾ ɐ bĩˈdimɐ i ɐ ˈbɛlɐ du s̺ɨˈɾɐ̃w̃
gloss_en: Did you come to see the grape harvest and the evening candle?
notes: Regional <vindima> and betacism <ver> [ˈbɛɾ], <vela> [ˈbɛlɐ] per cintra1971 and alvarezperez2014; nasal diphthong [ɐ̃w̃] in <serão> per mateus_dandrade2000.
